Thanks for the ping — Ive spoken with Sales Ops and Legal. We can support a temporary no-PO path for pilots under these conditions:

1) Customer signs the SOW we have on file (BrightFoundry-SoW.pdf).
2) Finance receives a signed Temporary Billing Authorization (Ive attached the template: temp-authorization-template.docx).
3) The pilot invoice is limited to a single invoice up to $25,000; any additional spend requires a PO or new approval.
4) Sales will capture the HubSpot deal id (BF-2026-019) and mark the record "pilot-no-po" so AP knows to expect an exception.

If Finance is okay with that, we should confirm the remit/address and send a 30-day invoice upon activation. Evan — I can draft the billing authorization and route it for signature today if you confirm billing contact (email) and remit.

Ben Carter

- Deal flagged in HubSpot as "pilot-no-po" and assigned BF-2026-019
